messages:
Rina: Planning a rolling index rebuild for metrics_counter (concurrent) during the midnight window.
Hector: Which shards and what's the throttle plan?
Rina: Shards 10-19. We'll run 5 parallel workers, slice per-tenant ranges of 2% each, apply micro-batch throttle to 200r/s. Expect 2.5h total.\nIvy: Please add a HOLDPOINT at 1h mark to validate p99 and replica lag.\nJamal: Also pin the reporting service to v1.9.3 for the window; otherwise new telemetry might hit the new index too early.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: HOLDPOINT created at step "1h-check". Manual approval required to continue.\nRina: Added rollback steps: pause workers, shrink parallelism, and if necessary revert index via dropping new index and requeueing old queries.\ninfra-bot: infra-bot: micro-batch throttle configured. No infra restart required.\nHector: Add watch: replica_lag > 30s -> PAUSE. Also watch index_apply_error_count > 0 -> alert.\nIvy: Oncall acked; will monitor p50/p95/p99 and replica lag.\nJamal: pin command used:
```
service-pin set reporting v1.9.3 --until=2026-03-03T04:00:00Z
```
Rina: Canary slices starting 00:05 UTC. Will update after 1h checkpoint.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary started.\nIvy: 00:35 small p99 blip on shard 12 correlated with index cleanup statement ~9.8s. watch didn't trigger (threshold 10s). Recommend lowering to 8s.
Hector: Lowered watch to 8s.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: watch updated: index_apply_longer_than=8s -> PAUSE.
Rina: At 01:05 we hit HOLDPOINT. p99 steady, replica lag 15s. approving continuation.
Ivy: Approve -> continue.\nRina: Rolling to remaining shards. Will monitor for 30m after completion.\nJamal: Unpin scheduled at 05:00 UTC.\nRina: Completed successfully at 03:20 UTC. Logs archived to s3://redwood-ops/migrations/metrics_counter/2026-03.
Hector: Post-run note: next run reduce parallel workers to 3 for shards with heavy write rate.\nRina: Thanks team. Closing thread."
